summary: One tab and its panel. Re-exported from react-stately's collection Item — `title` is the tab label, children are the panel.
useWhen: a child of Tabs — it is not usable anywhere else

useInstead.when: it is a row in a dropdown list

composition.note: A collection item, not a rendered component: Tabs reads it to build the collection, so it never appears in the DOM itself. That is why it exposes no props of its own here — `key` and `title` are the collection's API.

guarantees: the tab/panel roles, ids and aria-controls pairing are supplied by Tabs, not by this element
requires: a stable `key` — it identifies the tab across renders and is what selection is expressed in
a `title` that reads as a label on its own

antiPatterns.dont: wrapping TabItem in a <div> or a fragment inside Tabs
antiPatterns.why: Tabs reads the collection from its direct children; a wrapper makes the item invisible to it

antiPatterns.dont: conditionally rendering TabItems with array indexes as keys
antiPatterns.why: selection is tracked by key, so the selected tab silently becomes a different tab
